scope: Recipient-supplied length and SHA-256 report for an exact authorized stock HTTPS read

first_failure.finding: The baseline served the complete bytes to stock curl but supplied no persisted read authorization selector for the explicit recipient report.

implementation_failure.finding: The existing deferred event guard safely rejected the new read admission payload. Migration 68 accepts the exact ordinary payload or the exact report-eligible payload under the same current recipient, policy and revision checks.

local.environment: macOS ARM, Go 1.27.4, stock curl 8.7.1 with exact loopback TLS certificate trust, actual PostgreSQL 16.15, disk custody, ordinary bearer and browser-cookie identities
assertions: A separate authenticated recipient used stock curl to retrieve the complete immutable artifact, verified exact bytes and computed the report values from its downloaded copy.

The service verifies the original request, file revision, length, digest and an eligible read-authorized event for the same recipient. HEAD, Range, conditional and old-shaped read admissions supply no eligible report selector.

The recipient report and receipt commit together. The database refuses a stand-alone report event. A same-key bearer or browser-cookie retry returns the identical receipt. New-key duplicates, changed digest, wrong actor and forged event fail.

Original sender reads preserve the historical report after closure. Recipient reads and retries still require a live receive grant. Current source lineage and original HTTPS, closure and receipt tests pass again.
The receipt marks the statement as recipient-reported. Receiver persistence and business processing remain unknown. No report created or authorized an onward delivery.

remaining: Run the exact report native Linux x86 and ARM steps and schema-68 backup and restore.
Add the report to ordinary evidence, CLI, browser and agent workflows. Any receiver-owned durability or business receipt needs a separate contract and evidence.
The complete AX05 and AX-J01/AX-J02 profiles stay open.
